title: Data Center Lead
description:
**Description:**

Client is seeking a Datacenter Site Operations Lead to support a large-scale infrastructure and cloud operations environment. This role will be responsible for operational governance, production readiness, infrastructure visibility, compliance support, and cross-functional coordination across datacenter operations.

The ideal candidate will bring a blend of datacenter operational expertise, infrastructure governance experience, and strong stakeholder management skills. This individual will help ensure datacenter environments transition successfully from deployment into production operations while maintaining operational excellence, scalability, and compliance standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Datacenter Operations & Infrastructure Management**

Manage and maintain visibility across datacenter infrastructure, including power, cooling, rack utilization, capacity, and operational health.

Establish and track operational KPIs and metrics to measure datacenter readiness, performance, and reliability.

Monitor infrastructure capacity allocations and ensure accurate lifecycle management and reporting.

Maintain operational discipline across systems of record and infrastructure documentation.

**Operational Readiness & Production Transition**

Lead operational acceptance and production handoff activities for newly deployed datacenter environments.

Validate operational readiness criteria alongside engineering, build, and operations teams.

Ensure monitoring, documentation, processes, ownership models, and capacity controls are established prior to operational acceptance.

Identify readiness gaps and drive remediation efforts before systems enter production.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

Serve as a key liaison between infrastructure, operations, engineering, platform, facilities, and reliability teams.

Coordinate operational escalations, issue resolution efforts, and dependency management activities.

description: Join the Clean Energy Revolution Become a Clean Energy Project Management Manager at Southern California Edison (SCE) and build a better tomorrow. In this job, you will work in the Clean Energy Project Management (CEPM) group in Transmission & Distribution and will be responsible for leading a cross function project management team as they oversee Clean Energy projects throughout the SCE territory. Transportation Electrification (TE) is a critical strategic initiative for Southern California Edison (SCE) and we are taking a leading role to ensure that TE plays a major part in the reduction of greenhouse gas (GHG) and criteria pollutant emissions in California. The transportation sector is one of the largest consumers of energy, second to electric power generation, with most of the energy consumed coming from petroleum. Electrifying the transportation sector and reducing petroleum usage is critical to realizing California’s ambitious climate and air quality goals. In addition to cleaning and modernizing the grid, SCE is offering tariffs to support charger availability, make electric fueling more affordable and increase awareness of the benefits of electric transportation. Ensure appropriate resources are in place to manage Program Management work and to meet corporate goals and objectives.
